title: Vision Token Pruning via Query-Vision Interaction Decomposition
title_zh: 基于查询-视觉交互分解的视觉令牌剪枝

paragraphs.en: Large vision-language models (VLMs), which process both visual inputs and text queries, incur high inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens, making visual token pruning a natural approach for improving efficiency. Recent work has leveraged query information to guide token selection, often through heuristics derived from attention patterns or token dynamics. However, these approaches do not explicitly exploit the underlying structure of query–vision interactions. We address this gap by observing that the query–vision interaction matrix, naturally induced by the query and key projections already present in transformer attention, is effectively low-rank, with a small number of dominant latent interaction modes capturing query-relevant semantics. Motivated by this observation, we propose Query-Vision Decomposition (QViD), a novel training-free query-aware visual token pruning method that exploits this structure. Extensive experiments on both image and video understanding benchmarks show that QViD consistently improves performance under matched token budgets, with the largest gains appearing under aggressive compression regimes.
paragraphs.zh: 大型视觉语言模型（VLMs）同时处理视觉输入和文本查询，由于视觉token数量庞大而产生高昂的推理成本，因此视觉token剪枝是提升效率的一种自然方法。 近期工作利用查询信息来引导token选择，通常通过从注意力模式或token动态中导出的启发式方法实现。 然而，这些方法并未显式地利用查询—视觉交互的底层结构。 我们通过观察到查询—视觉交互矩阵（由transformer注意力中已有的query和key投影自然产生）实际上是低秩的，填补了这一空白，其中少量主导的潜在交互模式即可捕获与查询相关的语义。 受这一观察启发，我们提出了查询—视觉分解（QViD），这是一种新颖的免训练、查询感知的视觉token剪枝方法，利用了这一结构。 在图像和视频理解基准上的大量实验表明，QViD在相同token预算下始终能提升性能，且在高压缩率的情况下增益最为显著。

paragraphs.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of multimodal tasks, including visual question answering, optical character recognition, diagram understanding, and video comprehension [ 13 , 19 , 9 ] . In a typical VLM, a vision encoder produces vision tokens from an image, and the language model jointly processes these vision tokens together with the text query to generate a final response. However, this design also creates a major efficiency bottleneck: an image can produce hundreds to thousands of vision tokens, making multimodal inference expensive in both latency and memory. Consequently, reducing the cost of processing vision tokens has become an important focus of recent work on efficient VLM inference.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）已经在广泛的多模态任务中展现出强大的性能，包括视觉问答、光学字符识别、图表理解和视频理解 [13, 19, 9]。 在典型的 VLM 中，视觉编码器从图像生成视觉 token，语言模型将这些视觉 token 与文本查询一起联合处理，以生成最终响应。 然而，这种设计也造成了主要的效率瓶颈：一张图像可以产生数百到数千个视觉 token，使多模态推理在延迟和内存方面都非常昂贵。 因此，降低处理视觉 token 的成本已成为近期高效 VLM 推理工作的一个重要焦点。

paragraphs.en: A direct remedy is to reduce the number of visual tokens passed to the language model. Several training-free token compression methods have been proposed for this purpose, and many of them use attention-guided signals. For example, FastV [ 4 ] and SparseVLM [ 21 ] use early-layer attention patterns to score visual tokens, then prune tokens with low importance scores. While intuitive and often effective, these methods can be biased: vision tokens that are closer to the text tokens in the sequence may receive higher attention scores even when they are not the most relevant to the query. As a result, attention-based scores do not always provide a reliable measure of true query relevance.
paragraphs.zh: 一个直接的补救方法是减少传递给语言模型的视觉标记数量。 为此，已有多种无需训练的标记压缩方法被提出，其中许多方法使用注意力引导的信号。 例如，FastV [4] 和 SparseVLM [21] 利用早期层的注意力模式为视觉标记打分，然后剪除重要性得分较低的标记。 这些方法虽然直观且往往有效，但可能存在偏差：在序列中距离文本标记较近的视觉标记即使与查询并非最相关，也可能获得较高的注意力得分。 因此，基于注意力的得分并不总能可靠地衡量与查询的真实相关性。

paragraphs.en: The second paradigm is attention-free token pruning. A strong representative of this line of work is V 2 Drop [ 3 ] , which shows that an attention-free pruning signal can outperform earlier attention-based methods. Instead of using attention scores, it ranks vision tokens by how much their hidden states change across consecutive LLM layers, and drops tokens that change the least. This avoids the positional bias of attention-based scores. Since visual and text tokens are processed jointly, the variation signal can still reflect some influence from the query, but only indirectly. It captures generic token activity rather than explicitly measuring query–vision relevance.
paragraphs.zh: 第二种范式是无注意力的词元剪枝。 这一研究方向的一个有力代表是 V 2 Drop [ 3 ]，它表明无注意力的剪枝信号可以超越早期的基于注意力的方法。 它不使用注意力分数，而是根据视觉词元的隐藏状态在连续的 LLM 层之间的变化程度对其进行排序，并丢弃变化最小的词元。 这避免了基于注意力的分数所带来的位置偏差。 由于视觉词元和文本词元是联合处理的，变化信号仍然可以间接反映查询的某些影响。 它捕捉的是词元的一般活跃程度，而不是显式地度量查询与视觉内容的相关性。

paragraphs.en: This reveals a gap between the two paradigms: attention-guided methods are query-aware but inherit attention-score biases, while variation-based methods avoid attention scores but do not explicitly model the query. Our goal is to combine the strengths of both, enabling a query-conditioned pruning signal that does not rely on attention weights. This is particularly important because, in visual question answering and related tasks, the query determines what is relevant in the image. For example, in an image of an animal wearing a hat, as in Figure 1 , tokens depicting the animal are highly relevant for identifying it, but less relevant for questions about the background or surrounding objects. Ideally, a token selection method should therefore explicitly condition on the query, and more precisely on its underlying semantics. paragraphs.en: We show that query–vision interactions in VLMs, readily obtainable from standard transformer query–key projections, exhibit a strong low-rank structure, where task-relevant semantics concentrate into a small number of dominant interaction modes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，视觉语言模型（VLM）中可从标准 Transformer 的 query–key 投影中轻易获得的 query–视觉交互，呈现出强烈的低秩结构，其中与任务相关的语义集中在少数几种占主导地位的交互模式中。

paragraphs.en: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) process visual and textual tokens jointly, and recent advances toward higher-resolution images and longer videos have significantly increased the number of visual tokens [ 14 , 13 , 19 , 9 , 12 ] . This has led to a growing line of work on visual-token compression for efficient VLM inference. In this section, we review existing approaches to visual-token compression and position our method within this landscape. Our focus is on training-free visual-token pruning , which is complementary to improvements in the vision encoder, projector, or LLM backbone.

sents.en: Our focus is on training-free visual-token pruning , which is complementary to improvements in the vision encoder, projector, or LLM backbone.
sents.zh: 我们的关注点是无训练的视觉词元剪枝，它与视觉编码器、投影层或 LLM 主干的改进相互补充。

paragraphs.en: A common approach to reducing visual-token cost is to prune or merge tokens based on importance scores. Attention-guided methods such as FastV [ 4 ] and SparseVLM [ 21 ] use attention patterns inside the LLM to identify important visual tokens, while PDrop [ 20 ] progressively reduces the token count across layers. Token merging methods such as ToMe [ 2 ] and LLaVA-PruMerge [ 17 ] reduce sequence length by combining similar visual tokens instead of discarding them. While effective, attention-based scoring requires access to attention matrices, making it less compatible with memory-efficient implementations such as FlashAttention [ 5 ] , and can suffer from positional bias in autoregressive LLMs [ 3 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 降低视觉token成本的常见方法是根据重要性分数对token进行剪枝或合并。 FastV [ 4 ] 和 SparseVLM [ 21 ] 等注意力引导的方法利用LLM内部的注意力模式来识别重要的视觉token，而 PDrop [ 20 ] 则逐层递减token数量。 ToMe [ 2 ] 和 LLaVA-PruMerge [ 17 ] 等token合并方法通过合并相似的视觉token而非丢弃它们来缩短序列长度。 尽管有效，基于注意力的评分需要访问注意力矩阵，这使其与 FlashAttention [ 5 ] 等节省内存的实现不太兼容，并且在自回归LLM中可能受到位置偏差的影响 [ 3 ] 。

paragraphs.en: V 2 Drop [ 3 ] avoids explicit attention scores by measuring how much each visual token changes across consecutive LLM layers. Tokens with small hidden-state variation are treated as “lazy tokens” and pruned. This makes V 2 Drop naturally compatible with FlashAttention and avoids attention-position bias. However, the variation signal is largely task-agnostic: it captures generic token dynamics rather than explicitly modeling query–vision relevance. In contrast, QViD constructs a query–vision interaction matrix and ranks tokens based on their participation in its dominant low-rank structure, yielding a training-free pruning rule that is explicitly conditioned on the input query.
paragraphs.zh: V 2 Drop [ 3 ] 通过测量每个视觉 token 在连续 LLM 层之间的变化程度，避免使用显式的注意力分数。 隐状态变化较小的 token 被视为「惰性 token」并被剪枝。 这使得 V 2 Drop 天然兼容 FlashAttention，并避免了注意力位置偏差。 然而，这种变化信号在很大程度上是与任务无关的：它捕捉的是通用的 token 动态，而不是显式地建模查询与视觉之间的相关性。 相比之下，QViD 构建一个查询—视觉交互矩阵，并根据 token 在其主导低秩结构中的参与程度对 token 进行排序，从而得到一种显式以输入查询为条件的免训练剪枝规则。

paragraphs.en: Advantages over Attention Scores. This construction is closely related to the pre-softmax attention computation, but differs in two important ways. First, we compute the interaction before positional encoding. In autoregressive LLMs, positional encoding can bias attention toward visual tokens that are closer to the query tokens in the sequence, regardless of their semantic relevance. Since several prior pruning methods, such as SparseVLM and FastV, rely on attention scores for token selection, this positional bias can directly affect pruning decisions. By removing positional effects, M M captures a purely content-based query–vision interaction signal.
paragraphs.zh: 相对于注意力得分的优势。 这种构建方式与 softmax 之前的注意力计算密切相关，但在两个重要方面有所不同。 首先，我们在位置编码之前计算交互。 在自回归大语言模型中，位置编码会使注意力偏向于在序列中距离查询 token 较近的视觉 token，而不管其语义相关性如何。 由于一些先前的剪枝方法（如 SparseVLM 和 FastV）依赖注意力得分来进行 token 选择，这种位置偏差会直接影响剪枝决策。 通过去除位置效应，M M 捕获了纯粹基于内容的查询–视觉交互信号。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares QViD with prior visual-token compression methods under matched token budgets. We report the mean normalized performance relative to the full-token baseline. QViD achieves the best average performance at all three token budgets. paragraphs.en: We presented QViD, a training-free visual-token pruning method that explicitly conditions on the query without relying on attention weights. QViD constructs the query–vision interaction matrix induced by standard transformer query–key projections and scores visual tokens using its dominant low-rank subspace, retaining tokens that participate in the main query-relevant interaction modes. Across image and video benchmarks and multiple VLMs, QViD improves performance under matched token budgets, with the largest gains under aggressive compression. These results show that a few dominant SVD components are sufficient to capture much of the task-relevant query–vision structure, establishing low-rank query–vision decomposition as a simple, interpretable, and training-free basis for efficient VLM inference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 QViD，一种无需训练的视觉 token 剪枝方法，它显式地以查询为条件，而不依赖注意力权重。 QViD 构建由标准 transformer 查询–键投影诱导的查询–视觉交互矩阵，并利用其主导低秩子空间对视觉 token 进行评分，保留参与主要查询相关交互模式的 token。 在图像和视频基准以及多个视觉语言模型上，QViD 在相同的 token 预算下提升了性能，且在激进压缩下增益最大。 这些结果表明，少数主导的 SVD 分量足以捕捉大部分与任务相关的查询–视觉结构，从而确立了低秩查询–视觉分解作为一种简单、可解释且无需训练的高效视觉语言模型推理基础。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation is limited to public VLMs and standard image/video benchmarks, and may not fully capture behavior on closed-source models, proprietary inference stacks, or specialized domains. As a training-free pruning method, QViD also inherits the biases and failure modes of the underlying VLM. Practical speedups may vary with hardware, batching, sequence length, and attention-kernel implementations. Future work could extend query–vision decomposition to adaptive token budgets, dynamic selection of the number of SVD components and tighter integration with hardware-aware inference systems. It would also be valuable to study whether the same low-rank interaction structure can guide token pruning during training, in longer video settings, or in broader multimodal architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估仅限于公开的视觉语言模型和标准的图像/视频基准，可能无法充分反映闭源模型、专有推理栈或特定领域中的行为。 作为一种免训练的剪枝方法，QViD 同样继承了底层视觉语言模型的偏差与失效模式。 实际的加速效果可能因硬件、批处理、序列长度以及注意力核实现的不同而有所差异。 未来的工作可以将查询–视觉分解扩展到自适应 token 预算、SVD 分量数量的动态选择，以及与硬件感知推理系统的更紧密集成。 研究同样的低秩交互结构能否在训练期间、更长的视频场景中，或更广泛的多模态架构中指导 token 剪枝，也将很有价值。

paragraphs.en: We further evaluate QViD on HallusionBench and COCO Captioning to test whether token compression preserves both hallucination robustness and open-ended generation quality. HallusionBench is a hallucination-sensitive benchmark and is reported using all-pair accuracy (aAcc), figure accuracy (fAcc), and question accuracy (qAcc). COCO Captioning is evaluated using CIDEr, a caption-quality metric based on consensus between generated captions and human reference captions. CIDEr is not an accuracy metric; in our lmms-eval setup it is reported on a normalized scale, where values around 1.0 roughly correspond to a traditional CIDEr score around 100. Higher is better for all metrics.
